checkout_money_valid.name: checkout_money_valid
checkout_money_valid.value: "checkout"."currency" = 'EUR' and "checkout"."subtotal_cents" >= 0 and "checkout"."discount_cents" between 0 and "checkout"."subtotal_cents" and "checkout"."tip_cents" >= 0 and "checkout"."tax_cents" >= 0 and "checkout"."total_cents" = "checkout"."subtotal_cents" - "checkout"."discount_cents" + "checkout"."tip_cents" and "checkout"."total_cents" <= 999999999

checkout_line_valid.name: checkout_line_valid
checkout_line_valid.value: "checkout_line"."quantity" between 1 and 1000 and "checkout_line"."unit_amount_cents" between 0 and 999999999 and "checkout_line"."tax_basis_points" between 0 and 10000
